## What this changes

## For rule changes

- [ ] Every new or changed rule has at least one `match` and one `no_match` example
- [ ] `reclaim` prefers the owning app's own command or setting
- [ ] Nothing personal is labelled `safe`
- [ ] Paths use Windows locations (`%LOCALAPPDATA%` and so on), no real user names

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run eval` pass locally (CI runs them too)
